WV6-P01.5.note: The closing details (a cheer instead of the bell, conversation from asking the time, the driver claiming a ticket) are gently comic, so the narrator is amused, not detached, admiring, indignant, or regretful.

WV6-P02.5.note: The author points up the irony (keeping the sheep away to save the starwort, then bringing them back to save it, amid some laughter), and that is amusement; the decision rests on evidence, so critical does not fit.
